oth `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required: `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but
a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.
106:- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 ca
ses to the suite in one call: the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files wit
hout a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported i
ndividually: a `failed`…
107:- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-su
ites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and persists them: th
e only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.
108:- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): T
he sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person alrea
dy wrote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered s
teps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…
110:- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-aut
horing-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or propo
sed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.
111:- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite
and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.
112:- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the sui
te. Past runs that executed it are not affected.
113:- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update: omitted field
s are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks`
accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.
120:- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK mod
el leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases als
o expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must d
o.
128:- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-det
erministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60
-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged
draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…
137:- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in
the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends: the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.
144:- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused
while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it: the error names what to detach first. Guest call
ers are denied (a write).
